name: Варшав Шахтар Pro School
description:
“Варшав” — Shakhtar Pro School is a Ukrainian-founded football academy in Warsaw, coaching kids and adults since 2022. We train groups of 4–17 year-olds twice a week at our own pitch complex on Wybrzeże Szczecińskie (Praga-Południe), with winter sessions in the covered OTR hall. Coaches hold UEFA C/B licences and work in Polish, English and Ukrainian, which makes the club a natural home for both local and newly-arrived families.

Every age band has its own curriculum: fun-first ball mastery for the youngest, small-sided games and positional play for school age, and a league squad for teenagers. Adults can join the Wednesday 5-a-side amateur league. The first trial training is free — bring boots and a bottle.

services.description: Play-based foundation group: ball mastery, coordination and first mini-matches in a bilingual PL/UK environment.

services.title: Kids football 8–12 “Development”
services.description: Two trainings + Saturday league game. Technique circuits, 1v1 duels, positional play; monthly progress report for parents.

services.title: Teens 13–17 “Competition”
services.description: Three weekly sessions and Mazovia youth league; physical prep block in winter at the OTR Góraszka hall.

services.title: Adults 5-a-side (Wed nights)
services.description: Amateur Wednesday league — join as a player or bring your team. Match referee and physio on site.

services.title: Trial training
services.description: Free first session, gear rental included. Sign-up via site or Instagram DM.

name: Crocodile
description:
“Crocodile” is a family swimming school on a 25 m pool at ul. Płowżecka (Ursynów), teaching water confidence from 18 months to adults for over a decade. Warm water (29–30°C), groups of maximum six swimmers and patient certified instructors — including lifeguard-trained staff who competed in Polish championships.

Children progress through a visible badge ladder reported to parents every month; adults run lanes early morning, fix technique on video, or unwind in aqua aerobics. The saunas and the toddler SPA session on Saturdays make it a weekend ritual for Warsaw families.

services.title: Learn to swim 4–7
services.description: Badge system from doggy-paddle to 25m independence. Groups capped at six kids.

services.title: Stroke technique 8+
